messages:
Riley: Quick follow-up thread for the token-ttl drift + missing audit events incident. Want concrete owners, short timelines, and a recurring detection plan. Keep replies short so I can paste into the postmortem doc.
Omar: I'll take secrets/token rotation. Plan: rotate critical machine tokens first (ci-runner, infra-deploy, billing-worker). Validate with a staged smoke and then revoke. ETA: critical rotation in 36 hours, full sweep in 6 days.
Jin: I'll own the permissions tidy-up and investigate any stale role bindings. I'll run a short script to map service identities to active deployments and drop unused principals. ETA: 4 business days for PR + rollout plan.
Tess (infra): For the audit gap, I'm going to enable a higher sampling rate on the forwarder for the token endpoints for 12h and add a temporary passthrough to the cold storage to avoid indexing lag. I'll watch disk/egress. ETA: 2-6 hours to put safeguards in place.
Nora (sec): I'll take the recurring detection piece. Proposal: daily ingestion healthcheck, weekly token-ttl drift diff, and monthly perms snapshot. I'll own the alert rules and the triage runbook.
watchdog-bot: Created SEC-933: "token-ttl drift & audit follow-up" assigned to Riley. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-933
Riley: Added short validation steps to SEC-933. Quick checks for oncall after rotation: `HTTP/1.1 200` on introspect + body contains `"active": true` for new token; old token returns `401` or `"active": false`.
Omar: Rotation stub I plan to run: ```
# rotate-token example
1) generate new token in KMS
2) stage config to canary service
3) run introspect smoke against canary
4) roll forward to remaining services
5) revoke old token
```
Jin: Permissions audit commands: `gcloud iam roles list --project=redwood-prod --format=json` and `kubectl get rolebinding --all-namespaces -o json`. I'll post a CSV mapping principals->services.
Tess (infra): Forwarder override snippet: ```
# forwarder-override.yaml
filters:
  include:
    - event: token.issue
    - event: token.introspect
    - level: info
```
Tess (infra): Also putting an autoscale rule: if forwarder_disk_util > 70% -> add shipper; if >85% for 30m -> page #eng-infra.
Nora (sec): Recurring detection details: daily audit-ingest success (last-24h indexed count vs expected), weekly token-ttl-diff (compare current median TTL to baseline), monthly perms delta with auto-ticket if >5% drift. I'll add playbook steps for noisy alerts.
Riley: Action list summary (short): Omar -> rotate critical tokens (36h) + sweep (6d); Jin -> perms audit + PR (4d); Tess -> forwarder safeguards + autoscale (2h); Nora -> alerts + recurring detection (owned). Review/check-in scheduled in 3 business days.
watchdog-bot: Reminder: schedule review meeting SEC-933 in 3 business days. Attendees: Riley, Omar, Jin, Tess, Nora.
Omar: One question  we find clients failing post-rotate, do we have a rollback pattern? I propose a staged revoke window (24h) and ability to re-issue old token if needed.
Riley: Agreed. We'll keep an emergency rollback key and document the steps in SEC-933.
Jin: If perms removals risk blocking deploys, I'll tag changes with canary namespaces and coordinate with deploy owners before merge.
Tess (infra): I'll also add a short-lived metric to /ops/health for token-introspect latency during rotation window.
Nora (sec): I'll follow up with a short checklist in SEC-933 for the oncall to run post-rotation smoke (commands + expected results).
Riley: Thanks everyone. This thread is the single source for owners/times. Please paste PR links and ticket updates into SEC-933 rather than replies here.
